notes: Synthetic, clearly-labelled fixtures. Never production/JDdS data. Each case pairs a claim with the evidence a run would retrieve and a HUMAN label for whether the evidence semantically supports the claim. Labels are one of supported | unsupported | conflicting | indeterminate.
